def VTask.bitCasesOn : {motive : ℕ → Sort u} → (n : ℕ) → (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive (Nat.bit b n)) → motive n :=
  fun {motive} n bit =>
    (Nat.strong_induction_on n fun n ih =>
      match n with
      | 0 =>
        -- Base case: n = 0
        -- 0 = bit false 0
        bit false 0
      | 1 =>
        -- Base case: n = 1
        -- 1 = bit true 0
        bit true 0
      | n + 2 =>
        -- Inductive step: n + 2
        -- (n + 2) = bit ((n + 2) % 2 = 1) ((n + 2) / 2)
        have h₁ : (n + 2) = Nat.bit ((n + 2) % 2 = 1) ((n + 2) / 2) := by
          have h₂ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := by omega
          cases h₂ with
          | inl h₂ =>
            -- Case: (n + 2) % 2 = 0
            have h₃ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₂
            have h₄ : (n + 2) / 2 = (n / 2 + 1) := by
              have h₅ : (n + 2) = 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) := by
                omega
              have h₆ : (n + 2) / 2 = (n / 2 + 1) := by
                omega
              exact h₆
            have h₇ : (n + 2) = Nat.bit false ((n + 2) / 2) := by
              simp [Nat.bit, h₃, h₄]
              <;> ring_nf at *
              <;> omega
            have h₈ : (n + 2) % 2 = 1 ↔ False := by
              simp [h₃]
            simp_all [h₈]
            <;> aesop
          | inr h₂ =>
            -- Case: (n + 2) % 2 = 1
            have h₃ : (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₂
            have h₄ : (n + 2) / 2 = (n / 2 + 1) := by
              have h₅ : (n + 2) = 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) + 1 := by
                omega
              have h₆ : (n + 2) / 2 = (n / 2 + 1) := by
                omega
              exact h₆
            have h₇ : (n + 2) = Nat.bit true ((n + 2) / 2) := by
              simp [Nat.bit, h₃, h₄]
              <;> ring_nf at *
              <;> omega
            have h₈ : (n + 2) % 2 = 1 ↔ True := by
              simp [h₃]
            simp_all [h₈]
            <;> aesop
        -- Use the inductive hypothesis to get the result
        have h₂ : motive ((n + 2)) := by
          have h₃ : (n + 2) = Nat.bit ((n + 2) % 2 = 1) ((n + 2) / 2) := h₁
          have h₄ : ((n + 2) / 2) < (n + 2) := by
            have h₅ : (n + 2) / 2 < (n + 2) := by
              apply Nat.div_lt_self
              <;> omega
            exact h₅
          have h₅ : motive (Nat.bit ((n + 2) % 2 = 1) ((n + 2) / 2)) := by
            apply bit
          have h₆ : (n + 2) = Nat.bit ((n + 2) % 2 = 1) ((n + 2) / 2) := h₁
          have h₇ : motive ((n + 2)) := by
            simpa [h₆] using h₅
          exact h₇
        exact h₂
    )
